content_blocks.text: The old house on Maple Street had always been a mystery to the residents of Riverbank. Its windows were always shuttered, and no one ever saw anyone inside. On this cold winter evening, the silence was punctuated only by the distant hoots of an owl. As Isolde Myles approached, her heart raced with anticipation. She had heard rumors of a secret room hidden behind a false wall, a place where the house's previous owner, a reclusive artist, kept his most treasured works. Tonight, she hoped to uncover the truth.
